name: Lugh
abilities: Cernan: Sídhe Court Covenant Renewal Rite
Divine Ascension — Tír na nÓg Moon-Sovereign Form
passives: Geas Bloom: Cernan gains Geas when sustain play banks survival value through terrain mastery and converts it into recovery on sídhe-root crossing. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a geas sovereignty rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Avalora.
lore: Lugh, Many-Skilled Radiance, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Tuatha. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: many-skilled god of mastery, radiance, spear, craft and precise victory from afar. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses many-skilled god of mastery, radiance, spear, craft and precise victory from afar; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Tuatha canon.
visualDescription: Lugh manifests as many-skilled god of mastery, radiance, spear, craft and precise victory from afar from Tuatha: handsome youthful masculine champion face, golden eyes, clean jaw, focused confident smile; lean athletic masculine duelist build, long arms, dancer balance, poised ranged-strike posture; signature silhouette: long radiant spear line, sun cloak, tool charms, spear-caster profile. Weapon: Spear of Assal-like radiant long spear and sling of light. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Cernan — Silver-Branch Cut Restore
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Tuatha source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Geas Memory gain when used from silver-root fae ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as silver branches, living oak armor, thorn mantles, standing stones, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, moonlit green-gold, geas scars.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Geas Thorn Technique — Covenant
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to restores through faction ritual, cleanses pressure, and rewards holding sacred ground without becoming a passive healer. Builds Geas Memory only when the player uses silver-root fae ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Cernan: Sídhe Court Covenant Renewal Rite
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Geas Memory to impose a two-round rule from Avalora: restores through faction ritual, cleanses pressure, and rewards holding sacred ground without becoming a passive healer. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Tír na nÓg Moon-Sovereign Form
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Geas Memory, transform nearby terrain into silver-root fae ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Cernan Restorer Lugh Silver-Spear Thornblade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through silver-root fae ground. Visual: silver branches, living oak armor, thorn mantles, standing stones, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, moonlit green-gold, geas scars.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Cernan Moon-Oak Sídhe Mantle
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Avalora source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Cernan Dagda Cauldron Memory Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Geas Memory and unlocks a mastery branch for Sídhe Mound Slip, Fae Glamour Reversal, and Collect the Geas Debt. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: win attrition and cleanse hazard pressure
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Cernan's Geas Bloom: a solo mechanic where Geas grows through sídhe-root crossing, reaction-window mastery, and sustain decisions that bank survival value through terrain mastery and convert it into recovery. Payoff: survive long missions without ally healing or generic lifesteal. Counterplay: anti-heal pressure and hazard denial starve recovery; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: anti-heal pressure and hazard denial starve recovery
